name: openbb_options_chains
description:
Option chain for one underlying through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.options.chains).
Returns: {symbol, provider, data_points (all contracts), truncated, chain: contracts with expiration, strike, option_type, bid, ask, volume, open interest, implied volatility}, nearest expiries first, or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; limit (contracts; default 100); provider (intrinio, yfinance; default yfinance).
One expiry: yf_options_chain (dates from yf_options_expiries). Keys: yfinance needs none; intrinio needs a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"symbol": "SPY", "limit": 50}
